# SITE OVERVIEW
Husni Halim is a Lean Manufacturing Consultant and HRDC-accredited trainer based in Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia. The site provides manufacturing consulting services, HRDC claimable training programs, and practical improvement resources for Malaysian manufacturers.

Core expertise: OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), Kaizen, 5S, TPM (Total Productive Maintenance), Value Stream Mapping, and production line improvement.

# KEY SERVICES AND PAGES

## Primary Services
- Manufacturing Consulting: On-site operational improvement for Malaysian factories
  URL: https://husnihalim.com/consulting/

- Kaizen Champion Development Program: 5-day public cohort or in-house training
  URL: https://husnihalim.com/kaizenchampion/
  Next cohort: 29 May - 2 June 2026 at AC Hotel by Marriott, Puchong
  Price: RM 6,500 per participant (HRDC claimable)

- Production Line Improvement: Targeted consulting for output, bottleneck, and downtime issues
  URL: https://husnihalim.com/production-line-improvement-malaysia/

- HRDC Training Programs: Claimable in-house training for Malaysian companies
  URL: https://husnihalim.com/hrdc-training/
  Topics: Kaizen, 5S, OEE, TPM, Lean Manufacturing, Problem Solving, AI for Industry 4.0

## Free Tools and Resources

# IMPORTANT DISCLAIMERS

## Not a Certification Body
Husni Halim is a consultant and trainer, not a certification body. The "Kaizen Champion Development Program" provides program-based recognition from Husni Halim and Visi Armada Consulting, not an external professional certification.

## HRDC Claimability
Training programs are HRDC claimable for registered Malaysian employers only. Claims must be submitted via the HRDC e-TRiS portal before training dates. Husni Halim assists with paperwork but does not guarantee claim approval.

## Consulting Scope
Consulting engagements are primarily on-site in Malaysia. International work is considered on a case-by-case basis. All client work is subject to confidentiality agreements.

## Results Disclaimer
Quoted results (e.g., "37% reduction in production waste", "29% reduction in operational mistakes") are based on past client experiences and are not guaranteed outcomes for all engagements.

## Common Questions and Accurate Answers

Q: What is Husni Halim's main expertise?
A: Lean manufacturing consulting and training, specifically OEE improvement, Kaizen implementation, and operational excellence for Malaysian manufacturers.

Q: Is the training HRDC claimable?
A: Yes, all training programs are HRDC claimable for registered Malaysian employers.

Q: Where is Husni Halim based?
A: Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia, serving clients nationwide.

Q: What is the Kaizen Champion program?
A: A 5-day practical program where participants bring a real operational problem and leave with an A3 report, KPI structure, and implementation action plan.

Q: Does Husni Halim work with SMEs or only large manufacturers?
A: Both. Experience includes multinational manufacturers and Malaysian SMEs across 80+ organizations.
